theme_strategy.theme_switch_mechanism: next-themes class toggle on root html element (with seamless switch between clean light recruiter report and high-contrast dark technical dashboard)
theme_strategy.concept: Dual-Archetype Fusion: Swiss precision data sheets (light mode for recruiter printable reports) merged with obsidian tactical command center (dark mode for developer analysis & roadmap exploration)

hierarchy_rules.hero_title: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-extrabold tracking-tight font-heading leading-tight
hierarchy_rules.metric_large: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-extrabold font-mono tracking-tight

entry_surfaces./: split hero with live JD paste interactive analyzer on right, value metrics and instant recruiter scorecard demo on left
entry_surfaces./login: branded split auth panel with product positioning and candidate readiness stats on left, login form on right
entry_surfaces./signup: branded split auth panel with instant onboarding checklist on left, signup form on right

navigation.type: sticky crystal glass bar with top blur

dashboard_analyze.layout: Bento Asymmetric Grid (8-column master + 4-column dynamic feed)

sections.title: Job Description & Role Target
components: JD text area with sample job presets (e.g. Senior Fullstack Engineer, DevOps Lead, Python Backend, React Frontend, Cloud Data Engineer)
Candidate profile selector & resume switcher
Instant Deterministic Analyzer button (rule-based NLP regex matching engine with synonym expansion)

sections.title: Match Intelligence & Readiness Ring
components: Animated Circular Match Gauge (0-100%) with color-coded grade (Exceptional 85%+, Solid 70-84%, Needs Upskilling <70%)
Sub-score breakdown bars: Technical Core, Tooling/Frameworks, Experience/Seniority, Project Scope, Keyword Density
Quick Stat pills: Total Req Skills, Matched (✓), Partial/Adjacent (⚠️), Missing (❌)

sections.title: Skills Diagnostic Matrix
components: Strong Skills Panel (✓ validated with candidate proficiency badge and proof from resume)
Missing / Gap Skills Panel (❌ critical blockers + ⚠️ adjacent skills) with severity tags (High Priority vs Nice-to-have)

sections.title: Interactive Learning Roadmap & Dependency Chain
components: Numbered step-by-step learning cards with priority tags (HIGH / MEDIUM / LOW)
Estimated learning days badge per milestone + Total Sprint Duration
Visual dependency connector (e.g. Docker -> Kubernetes -> Helm; or TypeScript -> Next.js -> SSR Patterns)
Curated practice tasks & learning objectives per step

sections.title: Tiered Interview Question Vault
components: Tabs for: 1. Basic (Foundational concepts), 2. Intermediate (Practical debugging/architecture), 3. Project-Based (Scenario & system design), 4. JD-Specific (Direct requirements extracted from the target JD)
Expandable question cards with sample answer pointers, key discussion points, and what recruiters look for

sections.title: Recruiter View & PDF Print Ready Card
components: Official Recruiter Evaluation format with Verdict Stamp ('Strong Candidate', 'Interview with Prep', 'High Risk Skill Gap')
Top 3 Candidate Strengths & Top 3 Critical Red Flags
Export to PDF / Print-clean layout trigger

why_not_shortlisted.description: Aggregates all analyzed job descriptions across the platform / candidate history to pinpoint systemic gaps.
components: Market Demand Frequency Chart (e.g., 'Docker requested in 18/20 JDs', 'PostgreSQL in 16/20 JDs')
Biggest Recurring Blocker Callout: The single skill causing the most rejections/gaps across all pasted jobs
Competency Distribution Radar / Bar chart
Fast-track recommendations to unlock the highest percentage of job opportunities

job_comparison.description: Compares Job A vs Job B against the candidate's active profile.
components: Job A vs Job B selector dropdowns with quick preset comparison
Head-to-head match % meter with winner badge
Interactive Skill-by-Skill comparison table with ✓/❌ markers and overlap delta
Decision matrix: Which job offers faster interview readiness vs higher compensation upside

profile_skills_editor.layout: Interactive Tag Cloud & Categorized Skill Manager
components: Categorized skill pills (Languages, Frameworks, Cloud & DevOps, Databases, Architecture, Testing)
Proficiency level selector (Beginner, Intermediate, Advanced, Lead)
Resume text importer / parser that auto-populates skills from paste or pre-loaded resume
Quick-add custom skills with autocomplete

motion.principles: Deliberate and physical, snappy 200-300ms transitions for data interactions, staggered reveal for skill badges and learning roadmap steps.

accessibility.respect_reduced_motion: Wrap framer-motion components with useReducedMotion checks and fall back to instant render.

accessibility.wcag_compliance: WCAG 2.1 AA Compliant with >= 4.5:1 text contrast on all normal text surfaces and >= 3:1 for metric displays and icons.
accessibility.keyboard_navigation: Full keyboard accessibility on all modal dialogs, tab lists, accordion question cards, and roadmap steps with explicit focus rings.
accessibility.aria_roles: aria-expanded on accordions, role='status' on live calculations, aria-label on all action icon buttons.

developer_avatars.use_case: Candidate profile avatar in header and recruiter scorecard

deterministic_engine_spec.description: Rule-based pattern matching engine with pre-indexed tech dictionary covering 150+ skills, categorized into Core Languages, Frameworks, Databases, Cloud/DevOps, Architecture, and Testing.

recommendation_thresholds.< 65%: Significant Skill Gap / Needs Roadmap Completion

universal_rules: Every clickable button, link, tab, select, and report element MUST have a clear data-testid in kebab-case.
Support both Dark mode (sleek obsidian developer cockpit) and Light mode (crisp recruiter dossier look). Default to dark mode on initial load with an instant one-click toggle in the navbar.

Seed pre-filled demo data: 4 diverse candidate profiles (e.g. Fullstack Dev, Backend Python Dev, Junior React Dev, DevOps Specialist) and 5 realistic Job Descriptions (e.g. Senior Fullstack Engineer at Stripe-like fintech, Cloud Native Engineer at enterprise SaaS, Lead Frontend Architect, Python AI Platform Engineer, Junior Software Engineer) so the app works richly out of the box.
Implement PDF/Print Export for the Recruiter Report Card using browser print stylesheets (@media print) with clean white background, high-contrast typography, and official recruiter scorecard layout.
Provide comprehensive preset samples for one-click testing of all features including Job-to-Job comparison and Why Not Shortlisted intelligence charts.
